architecture: Residual GINE atom message passing, separate layers and edge encoders, virtual molecule nodes, jumping-knowledge attention/mean/max readout, task-gated chemical and graph experts
task_sampling: Uniform task, half sampled molecules from task and half from all authorized fitting molecules; loss over all labels observed in that batch. Each task loss normalized separately.
classification_loss: Unweighted BCE plus pairwise ranking 0.12; retain real prevalence
mae_loss: 0.9 absolute loss plus 0.1 Huber on fit-only median/IQR targets
rank_loss: Fit-only Gaussian rank, Huber plus pairwise ranking coefficient 0.15
selection: 3 global scaffold folds, leave-one-fold-out source/weight selection, official valid report-only. At least 2 positive folds and CV and held mean >0.002. Frozen selection checked on new 25% scaffold holdout with freshly refitted matched v27 graph control.
limitations: Development labels repeatedly reused. Baseline CV is historical proxy. Fresh validation compares retrained fixed v27 control, not full historical ensemble. Aggregate official scoring formula unavailable; no guaranteed score change.
